name: North cabin portal
notes: Nether side of the North cabin. Warped forest: no hostiles except endermen. Open floor around (-22, -243) with a basalt pillar. Start of the basalt-deltas search.

name: Snowy portal
notes: Nether side of the snowy north portal. Crimson forest: hoglins and piglins — wear one gold piece.

name: Home portal (Nether side)
notes: Nether end of the Home portal. Tunnel dug south from here at y 121.

name: Tunnel south
notes: The y-121 tunnel running south from the Home portal.

name: Cavern + lava crossing
notes: Tunnel breaks into a big cavern with warped forest on the floor. Someone's makeshift lava crossing is visible — possibly the same one seen from the North cabin portal, which would put the two portals in the same cavern system.
